actual_source_reads.title: NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde — Ectopic Pregnancy Medical Management (116)
actual_source_reads.retrieval_scope: Actual original HTML via urllib: Patient selection, Contra-indications to medical management, Pre-treatment investigations and Editorial information. Gynaecology Clinical Governance Group approved version4; review due2026-09-30 passed. Only stable blood-count/liver/kidney/lactation assessment used, no numerical thresholds/dose/efficacy imported. References RCOG2016/NICE2019; distinct from QLD compilation, shared clinical evidence.
actual_source_reads.copyright: Original institutional rights retained; factual original synthesis and locators only.

version_differences: NICE NG126 anti-D 2026与NHS旧treatment页2022冲突，使用现行指南+更新overview支持个体评估，不把旧所有手术后给药作为建议。
Queensland2025 p5 flowchart建议MTX后4个月，p22正文及其患者页为3个月；正文至少3个月且与团队商定，不宣称统一exact3个月。
RCOG2016罕见部位治疗较宽泛，SMFM2022/reaffirmed2024瘢痕妊娠更明确反对期待及单用全身MTX；正文不提供普遍观察方案。

category_decisions.rationale: 腹腔着床、广域影像/MRI、分阶段手术或筛选药物、失血及复诊已分别解释。
exclusions_considered: PUL不是确诊异位妊娠；JA01.Z为确诊类别未特指，不把未定位疑似直接编码。
腹腔/卵巢特指叶与非特指叶分开；残余其他特指通过宫颈/瘢痕/宫内外同时等路径，非穷举罕见亚型。
WHO2026-01明确排除 viable abdominal delivery JB23.3 及 viable abdominal maternal care JA86.6；本文异位急症照护不覆盖这些排除项。
remaining: 由独立审核员复核各部位及14维正向适用性。
